title: Rectangle Puzzle II
statementMd:
You are given a rectangle grid. That grid's size is $*n* × *m*$. Let's denote the coordinate system on the grid. So, each point on the grid will have coordinates — a pair of integers $(*x*, *y*)$ $(0 ≤ *x* ≤ *n*, 0 ≤ *y* ≤ *m*)$.

Your task is to find a maximum sub-rectangle on the grid $(*x*_{1}, *y*_{1}, *x*_{2}, *y*_{2})$ so that it contains the given point $(*x*, *y*)$, and its length-width ratio is exactly $(*a*, *b*)$. In other words the following conditions must hold: $0 ≤ *x*_{1} ≤ *x* ≤ *x*_{2} ≤ *n*$, $0 ≤ *y*_{1} ≤ *y* ≤ *y*_{2} ≤ *m*$, ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/0c36d1eac2611e4dc89474c61ba622f0db130f00.png).

The sides of this sub-rectangle should be parallel to the axes. And values $*x*_{1}, *y*_{1}, *x*_{2}, *y*_{2}$ should be integers.

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/ac3aa7cc3149c9508428a2289c61e2c69bfbea3a.png)

If there are multiple solutions, find the rectangle which is closest to $(*x*, *y*)$. Here "closest" means the Euclid distance between $(*x*, *y*)$ and the center of the rectangle is as small as possible. If there are still multiple solutions, find the lexicographically minimum one. Here "lexicographically minimum" means that we should consider the sub-rectangle as sequence of integers $(*x*_{1}, *y*_{1}, *x*_{2}, *y*_{2})$, so we can choose the lexicographically minimum one.

## Input

The first line contains six integers $*n*, *m*, *x*, *y*, *a*, *b*$ $(1 ≤ *n*, *m* ≤ 10^{9}, 0 ≤ *x* ≤ *n*, 0 ≤ *y* ≤ *m*, 1 ≤ *a* ≤ *n*, 1 ≤ *b* ≤ *m*)$.

## Output

Print four integers $*x*_{1}, *y*_{1}, *x*_{2}, *y*_{2}$, which represent the founded sub-rectangle whose left-bottom point is $(*x*_{1}, *y*_{1})$ and right-up point is $(*x*_{2}, *y*_{2})$.
statementZhMd:
你有一个矩形网格。该网格的大小为 $*n* × *m*$。我们为网格建立如下坐标系。因此，网格上的每个点都有坐标——一对整数 $(*x*, *y*)$ $(0 ≤ *x* ≤ *n*, 0 ≤ *y* ≤ *m*)$。

你的任务是在网格上找到一个最大的子矩形 $(*x*_{1}, *y*_{1}, *x*_{2}, *y*_{2})$，使其包含给定点 $(*x*, *y*)$，且其长宽比恰好为 $(*a*, *b*)$。换句话说，必须满足以下条件：$0 ≤ *x*_{1} ≤ *x* ≤ *x*_{2} ≤ *n*$，$0 ≤ *y*_{1} ≤ *y* ≤ *y*_{2} ≤ *m*$，![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/0c36d1eac2611e4dc89474c61ba622f0db130f00.png)。

该子矩形的边应与坐标轴平行，并且 $*x*_{1}, *y*_{1}, *x*_{2}, *y*_{2}$ 必须为整数。

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/ac3aa7cc3149c9508428a2289c61e2c69bfbea3a.png)

如果有多个解，找到距离 $(*x*, *y*)$ 最近的矩形。这里的“最近”是指 $(*x*, *y*)$ 与矩形中心之间的欧几里得距离最小。如果仍有多个解，则找到字典序最小的解。这里的“字典序最小”是指将子矩形视为整数序列 $(*x*_{1}, *y*_{1}, *x*_{2}, *y*_{2})$，从中选取字典序最小的一个。

## 输入格式

第一行包含六个整数 $*n*, *m*, *x*, *y*, *a*, *b*$ $(1 ≤ *n*, *m* ≤ 10^{9}, 0 ≤ *x* ≤ *n*, 0 ≤ *y* ≤ *m*, 1 ≤ *a* ≤ *n*, 1 ≤ *b* ≤ *m*)$。

## 输出格式

输出四个整数 $*x*_{1}, *y*_{1}, *x*_{2}, *y*_{2}$，表示所找到的子矩形，其中左下角为 $(*x*_{1}, *y*_{1})$，右上角为 $(*x*_{2}, *y*_{2})$。
